findings.claim: UntrustedData's object-graph depth limit is raised from 500 to 5000, so existing deserialization callers now accept payloads that previously exceeded the security limit, weakening denial-of-service protection. This runtime behavior change is unrelated to REQ-2283.

receipt_plan.detail: Deserialize a payload containing 501 nested arrays using MessagePackSerializerOptions.Standard.WithSecurity(MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData), asserting that deserialization throws for exceeding the depth limit. The test passes against the base build (limit 500) and fails against the head build (limit 5000).
